name: 云柔夹棉床垫加厚保护垫款
description: 云感绗缝开场，手压回弹与气流机制层层递进，双栏对照与机洗护理收口信任

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless studio fields alternating clean white #FFFFFF, warm ivory #F6F1E8 and pale mint #DCE9D2, plus calm bedroom and laundry frames on warm plaster and oat cabinet walls with pale oak floors
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft daylight-balanced key from the front-left at 5300-5500K with bounce fill, low contrast, gentle contact shadows, cool-neutral sweeping side light for texture, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: plush quilted channel tufting with a piped edge and a fitted side skirt wall, matte pale-oak floor and pale tile
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one headline plus short pill labels only, always carried on blank placeholder plates
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line glyphs inside flat rounded pill frames and round discs, bamboo green #3F6B33 on white, blank label slot beside each glyph
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 or low skim angle across the tufted surface, consistent textile scale and channel volume across the set, piped edge and skirt wall always readable, nothing covering the seam
noDrift: no printed wordmarks or hang tags on the textile
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent calm premium home-textile ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, warm ivory #F6F1E8, bamboo green #3F6B33 and pale mint #DCE9D2; warm bright soft daylight-balanced studio lighting with a front-left key, bounce fill and gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif used only on blank placeholder plates; thin single-weight line glyphs inside flat rounded pill frames and round discs; seamless studio fields alternating clean white, warm ivory and pale mint plus calm bedroom and laundry frames on warm plaster and oat cabinet walls with pale oak floors; the textile always rendered as a plush quilted channel surface with a piped edge and a fitted side skirt wall; stable product angle and scale across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表里用饱满绗缝体块与安静卧室底色抢第一眼点击，不依赖任何图内文字。

shots.lighting: bright soft daylight-balanced key from the front-left at 5400K with bounce fill, low contrast, one soft contact shadow where the skirt meets the mattress
shots.background: warm ivory studio-grade field #F6F1E8 with a plain headboard zone behind
shots.props: two plain unstamped pillows at the head, nothing else
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, an even margin around the silhouette for thumbnail reading
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}, laid flat and neatly smoothed over a made bed. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Camera low near mattress level at a slight 3/4 angle, looking gently upward along the rows of plush quilted channels toward two plain pillows at the head, full item visible and never clipped by the frame edges. Bright soft daylight-balanced key from the front-left at 5400K with a bounce fill on the shadow side, low contrast, one soft contact shadow where the skirt wall meets the mattress. Background a warm ivory studio-grade field #F6F1E8 with the headboard zone left plain. Props limited to two unstamped pillows. Negative: no hang tag, no woven label lettering, no press or media badge, no certification seal, no text of any kind, no hands, no person, no gradient background, no sagged or flattened channels, no floating textile without a contact shadow, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：01 铺好的床上近距离拍出饱满格状绗缝面，角上一枚织物织标与一枚媒体背书打孔吊牌；02 一只手压进绗缝格留下凹陷，左上英文大标题、左下两枚带勾胶囊标签；03 低掠视角的绗缝面上升起三支半透明箭头，左上标题加两行说明，左下两枚胶囊标签、右下一枚第三方纺织认证方标；04 一名女子侧卧在加厚垫上，上方一条虚线身体轮廓串四个节点，四条胶囊主张涉及缓解髋关节与脚踝不适、支撑脊柱；05 双手把围裙边拉紧贴床角，左下圆角卡片内为环形箭头与深袋英寸区间数值；06 洗衣机滚筒与藤编洗衣篮，左侧圆角护理卡写冷水洗涤与烘干，下方三枚胶囊标签含洗涤次数数值；07 双栏 OURS 与 OTHER 勾叉对照五行，左侧带品牌名。品类判定依据：七图主体一致为铺在床垫上的加厚保护垫（带绗缝格与弹性围裙边），故 L1 取家具家纺、L2 取床品，leaf 定为床垫加厚保护垫；与库内已有的床笠式防水保护罩款在结构上区分，本款主打加厚铺垫而非贴身罩。已剥离内容：原品牌织标与系列名、媒体背书吊牌与年份、第三方认证方标、全部原文案与原句、厚度与密度数值、深袋英寸区间、洗涤次数与水温程序字样、理疗类断言（缓解疼痛与支撑脊柱等主张）一律换成空白胶囊位、空参数行、空表格单元与留空印章框，双栏对照两侧的具体主张全部改为空白标签条且不指向任何真实竞品；模特面容改为背向镜头与虚焦裁切的泛化人物；面料上重复出现的字样印花改写为小型竹叶状提花图案，不带任何可读文字。
